label: Probability assignment: measure, additive function, frequency, likelihood
resolution: The carrier-probability controls use four different things called probability. PROBABILITY_ASSIGNMENT_1 is a normalized countably additive measure; PROBABILITY_ASSIGNMENT_2 is a normalized finitely additive real set function on the whole power set, possibly signed; PROBABILITY_ASSIGNMENT_3 is the limit of relative frequencies along a selected finite exhaustion; PROBABILITY_ASSIGNMENT_4 is an observer-conditioned likelihood under positive observer-cell weights. Each statement uses one sense. No result passes between senses as a premise: the all-subsets measure result converts a measure to its real set values inside its proof, and its statement uses sense 1 only. Impossibility of a uniform or all-permutation-invariant assignment in one sense is not absence of every assignment in that sense or another. This is distinct from probabilistic explanation and selection (DISAMB-PROBABILITY-EXPLANATION), which concerns chance, probability raising and ranking.
